{{Quote|Innovation is more important that technological limitations.|Saska Teft|<ref name="Twin Shadows" />}}
'''Saska Teft''' was an engineer who was allied with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the events of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She alongside [[Biv Bodhrik/Legends|Biv Bodhrik]] were dispatched to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to both investigate a growing Imperial presence on the planet and to find the freelance member [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who had disappeared during his assignment in investigating the planet at [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], as they were considered among the Rebel Alliance's best operatives.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Tosche Station is a dump.|Saska Teft|<ref name="Twin Shadows" />}}
Saska Teft had something of a shady past before joining the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in their fight against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and was also a skilled engineer. She eventually was sent to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to find [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and investigate rumors of a growing Imperial presence on the planet, working together with the guerrilla fighter [[Biv Bodhrik/Legends|Biv Bodhrik]].

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|As much as I like putting things together, I also like blowing them apart.|Saska Teft|<ref name="Twin Shadows" />}}
Saska Teft was extremely skilled with engineering, and was able to create various traps and devices including an energy shield and an andrenaline injector. She also had something of a shady past, having extensive knowledge of the criminal underworld, and even having contacts with various unsavory figures such as [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] hunters and the infamous [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] [[IG-88B/Legends|IG-88]].<ref name="Fight for Freedom" />

==Behind the scenes==
Saska Teft is one of two hero characters in the ''[[Twin Shadows]]'' expansion pack for the tactical land-based RPG game ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Assault]]'' by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].
